title: Issue Insight Suite Settings
description: Configure notifications, GitHub access, and critical time thresholds.

notificationRecipients.title: Notification recipients
notificationRecipients.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses that receive time-tracking alerts.

notifyOnCritical.title: Send email when the critical limit is reached
notifyOnCritical.description: When enabled, the critical time monitor sends an email once an issue crosses a boundary.

warningSpentTimeHours.title: Warning limit (hours)
warningSpentTimeHours.description: Default spent-time boundary that marks an issue as approaching the critical limit.

criticalSpentTimeHours.title: Critical limit (hours)
criticalSpentTimeHours.description: Default spent-time boundary that marks an issue as critical. Can be overridden per project in the Critical Threshold Configurator.

githubRepository.title: GitHub repository
githubRepository.description: Repository scanned for pull requests, in the owner/repo format, for example jetbrains/youtrack.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Personal access token with read access to the repository, its pull requests, and its workflow runs.
